slices.focus: Mother's blunt observation prompts Jae-hyun's post-shift recovery meal.
slices.summary: After his mother bluntly says he looks pale and sends him home with market mackerel, Jae-hyun discovers that simple grilled fish and rice after night shifts leaves him feeling better than convenience food or dock grease. The preference shift sticks: he now strongly favors simple home-cooked fish and rice after shifts, treating it as a 'standard recovery meal' rather than a strict diet rule.
open_loops: Backup options when fish is unavailable
Maintaining the habit during busy stretches
decisions: Jae-hyun now strongly favors simple home-cooked fish and rice after shifts because greasy dock meals aggravate his reflu
